DIM←18432
GRID←5
Token ← 2⥊ID EMB
KANState ← POT PHASE TIME PROFILE SPLINE
LorenzEmbed ← {σ ρ β ← 10 28 (8÷3)
DT ← 0.01
X0 ← 0.1×ID
Y0 ← 2×INDEX
Z0 ← 0
X1 ← X0 + DT × (σ × (Y0 - X0))
Y1 ← Y0 + DT × (X0 × (ρ - Z0) - Y0)
Z1 ← Z0 + DT × (X0 × Y0 - β × Z0)
PHASE ← (SIN X1) × (COS Y1) × (SIN Z1)
SINPHASE COSPHASE ← SIN COS PHASE
PHASE,SINPHASE,COSPHASE,σ,ρ,β,X1,Y1,Z1, (DIM-9)⥊0

BSplineBasis ← {DEG KNOTS X:
  {DEG=0? (X≥KNOTS) ∧ (X<1+KNOTS) ; (LEN KNOTS -1)⥊0}
}
KanSplineEval ← {COEFFS GRID X:
  KNOTS ← (GRID-1)÷⍳GRID
  BASIS ← BSplineBasis 3 KNOTS X
  +/ BASIS × COEFFS
}
HybridTokenize ← {TEXT GRID BIRTH:
  NORM ← TRIM (" "≡"  ") (" "≡"-") LOWER TEXT
  GRAPHS ← GRAPHEMES NORM
  INDEXMAP {ID ← AT (MAP GRAPHS) INDEX

    PHASESHIFT ← SIN (0.1×INDEX) + DEGREE
    LORENZSHIFT ← PHASESHIFT + LORENZ
    SPLINEX ← INDEX ÷ LEN TEXT
    COEFFS ← GRID⥊1
    SPLINEVAL ← KanSplineEval COEFFS GRID SPLINEX
    (0.01×SPLINEVAL) + LORENZSHIFT
    Token ID EMB
  } GRAPHS
}
Main ← {

  TOKENS ← HybridTokenize TEXT GRID ⟨25.52,18.58,15.27⟩

}

```bqn
DIM←18432
GRID←5
LorenzEmbed←{
  σ←10
  ρ←28
  β←8÷3
  dt←0.01
  x0←0.1×𝕩
  y0←2×𝕨
  z0←0
  x1←x0+dt×σ×y0-x0
  y1←y0+dt×x0×(ρ-z0)-y0
  z1←z0+dt×(x0×y0)-β×z0
  phase←(1⊸○x1)×(2⊸○y1)×1⊸○z1
  sinphase←1⊸○phase
  cosphase←2⊸○phase
  phase‿sinphase‿cosphase‿σ‿ρ‿β‿x1‿y1‿z1∾(DIM-9)⥊0
}
BSplineBasis←{
  deg 𝕊 knots‿x:
  deg=0?((x≥knots)∧(x<1+knots))∾(≠knots-1)⥊0;
  (≠knots-1)⥊0
}
KanSplineEval←{
  coeffs‿grid‿x 𝕊 𝕩:
  knots←(grid-1)÷↕grid
  basis←BSplineBasis 3‿knots‿x
  +´basis×coeffs
}
Trim←{((𝕩≠' ')⊸/)𝕩}
Lower←{𝕩-32×(𝕩≥@+'A')∧(𝕩≤@+'Z')}
GraphToId←{𝕩-@}
GetBirth←{𝕨⊑𝕩}
HybridTokenize←{
  text‿grid‿birth 𝕊 𝕩:
  norm←Lower Trim text
  len←≠norm
  indices←↕len
  tokens←{
    char←𝕨⊑norm
    id←GraphToId char
    idx←𝕨
    lorenz←idx LorenzEmbed id
    degree←idx GetBirth birth∾(len⥊0)
    phaseshift←(1⊸○0.1×idx)+degree
    lorenzshift←phaseshift+lorenz
    splinex←idx÷len
    coeffs←grid⥊1
    splineval←0
    finalemb←0.01×splineval+lorenzshift
    id‿finalemb
  }¨indices
  tokens
}
Main←{
  text←"JAIDE V33 BQN compute core"
  tokens←HybridTokenize text‿GRID‿⟨25.52,18.58,15.27⟩‿@
  "Hybrid BQN Compute Core Loaded for JAIDE V33 LLM"
}
Main@
```

```bqn
DIM←18432
GRID←5
LorenzEmbed←{
  σ←10
  ρ←28
  β←8÷3
  dt←0.01
  id←𝕩
  idx←𝕨
  x0←0.1×id
  y0←2×idx
  z0←0
  x1←x0+dt×σ×y0-x0
  y1←y0+dt×x0×(ρ-z0)-y0
  z1←z0+dt×(x0×y0)-β×z0
  phase←(1⊸○x1)×(2⊸○y1)×1⊸○z1
  sinphase←1⊸○phase
  cosphase←2⊸○phase
  result←phase‿sinphase‿cosphase‿σ‿ρ‿β‿x1‿y1‿z1
  padlen←DIM-≠result
  result∾padlen⥊0
}
BSplineBasis←{
  deg‿knots‿x 𝕊 𝕩:
  deg=0?(x≥knots[0])∧(x<1+knots[0]);0
}
KanSplineEval←{
  coeffs‿grid‿x 𝕊 𝕩:
  knotcount←grid
  knots←(↕knotcount)÷grid-1
  basis←0
  +´basis×coeffs
}
Trim←{
  mask←𝕩≠' '
  mask/𝕩
}
Lower←{
  chars←𝕩
  upper←(chars≥@+'A')∧(chars≤@+'Z')
  chars-32×upper
}
GraphToId←{
  𝕩-@
}
GetBirth←{
  idx←𝕨
  birth←𝕩
  len←≠birth
  idx<len?birth[idx];0
}
HybridTokenize←{
  text‿grid‿birth 𝕊 𝕩:
  norm←Lower Trim text
  len←≠norm
  indices←↕len
  tokens←{
    idx←𝕩
    char←idx<≠norm?norm[idx];@+32
    id←GraphToId char
    lorenz←idx LorenzEmbed id
    degree←idx GetBirth birth
    phaseshift←(1⊸○0.1×idx)+degree
    lorenzshift←phaseshift+lorenz
    splinex←idx÷len
    coeffs←grid⥊1
    splineval←coeffs‿grid‿splinex KanSplineEval 0
    finalemb←0.01×splineval+lorenzshift
    id‿finalemb
  }¨indices
  tokens
}
Main←{
  text←"JAIDE V33 BQN compute core"
  birth←⟨25.52,18.58,15.27⟩
```
